final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT d.A3 as region, AVG(t.amount) as avg_amount, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.avg_amount, s1.record_count, s1.avg_amount - s2.overall_avg as difference FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s1.avg_amount > s2.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as avg_avg_amount, AVG(record_count) as avg_record_count, AVG(difference) as avg_difference FROM step3
